canonical_project: CapitaLand Korea 1 and Korea 2 Hyangdong data centers
owner: CapitaLand, with GIC and Equinix participation
notes: Seoul Property Insight reports CapitaLand secured four Korean data-center site developments including two in Goyang Hyangdong and two in Hanam, with GIC/Equinix collaboration for the Hyangdong, Goyang projects. Baxtel lists Korea 1 and Korea 2 as adjacent Goyang/Seoul facilities but public MW figures were not found.
